editorial:
Imagine being stuck in a remote house with a traumatized witness while someone is trying to tie up loose ends. You get to follow Dr. Sam Graham, a psychologist who takes in a young girl named Finn after her parents are killed. The vibe is very tense and moody, making you feel like someone is always watching from the shadows. It starts off as a slow burn, focusing on the bond between Sam and Finn, but it quickly turns into a race for survival as people start dying around them. You will feel the pressure building as Sam realizes that the safe house isn't actually safe at all.

What really works here is the suspense and the way the mystery unfolds. The acting feels natural, and the twists will definitely keep you guessing until the end. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the payoff is totally worth it. If you love a good crime thriller, you should definitely check this out. It looks great if you can find it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but renting it on Apple TV is also a quick way to watch. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best quality.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the danger was much closer than Sam thought. It turns out Danny was involved in the crime and was trying to eliminate anyone who knew the truth. In the final scenes, Sam has to fight off Danny to protect Finn and her own daughter. After a tense struggle, the killer is stopped, and the police arrive to clean up the mess. Sam and the girls finally find peace knowing the truth is out.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and mystery twists.
